decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and data centers, so it can interpret early results and improve the service through its own R&D.

Document capture extends the firm's electronic document workflows and has its own dedicated page, but recognition technology sits a bit further from its messaging core, so there is moderate risk it gets refocused.
Email-to-fax conversion relies on long-held channel integration know-how and suits regulated customers who still depend on fax, so it fits well with existing capabilities.
As a feature very close to the established fax service it costs little to maintain, though it could be folded quietly into the base offering.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's email security portfolio, where its existing security knowledge lets it absorb new threat information and keep improving the product.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a natural extension of the existing secure messaging service, and the firm can easily operate and refine it with the knowledge it already holds.
